placement.reason: One-session feasibility did not provide enough concurrent KV capacity at high load
placement.selection: Static score shortlist; test w3 first, then w2 if w3 fails. Screening outcomes select the formal candidate; preserve all outcomes.

admission: FIFO source waiting; reserve prompt plus public maximum 1000 output tokens on all resident layers of visited GPUs; release on session completion; no future-output oracle, drops or preemption

formal.pass: Every paired seed must have identical trace_sha256, successful run, active GPUs <42, throughput >=Helix, P95 TTFT <=Helix and P95 TPOT <=Helix

optimization: Failed-route checks are cached only while request and reservation-capacity version are unchanged; validate scheduling parity on the original smoke trace.
